outcome.technical: tests/test_stamp_verification.py: sr39 no longer sizes a sleep against the deadline. New helpers above _final_pass_cases: _witness_test, _witness_time, _one_deadline_tries and _one_deadline_holds, plus the constants _FIRST_HOLD=2.0, _BEAT=0.05 and _DEADLINE_LADDER=(6,12,24). The suite tells its runs apart by whether newmod imports. The task's run stamps `first`, holds 2 s and re-raises the ImportError that makes a second run owed. The second run stamps `second` and then appends a heartbeat every 0.05 s until it is killed, so it can only end at the deadline. Each try writes the suite again with a witness directory of its own. The deadline doubles 6 -> 12 -> 24 until a try's second run stamps its witness. Every try must be exit 3 (E_CANNOT_PROVE) with 'timed out' in the basis. The try that reaches the second run must also have run.exit == 1 and run.second set, and its last heartbeat must be earlier than first + deadline + hold/2. With one deadline the beat is at most helper-start + deadline, and helper-start is before first. With a deadline per run the beat lands at least first + hold + deadline. The old `spent < 7 + 3*GRACE` bound is gone because it depended on runner speed; `took` is still printed. Green runs: standalone sr-final block exit 0 twice (beat-first 5.03 both times, second-first 2.08, took 5.3 s, bound 7.0). Gate `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_stamp_verification.py` exit 0 at 01:58:20, and again (with --loud) exit 0 at 01:59:04: 1/1 files ok, 333 cases. A probe patched the ladder in memory to (2,6). The 2 s try did not reach the second run and still held (exit 3, timed out); the 6 s try reached it and the verdict was True, so the slow-runner rung is exercised. ruff and vermin on the file both exit 0. prose_number_claims and house_style_violations report no hits in the file. Dependants: .github/sweep-costs.json is still correct. It records 32.5 s for the sr-final block, and the case now takes about 5.3 s on one rung, about 42 s at worst on all three, under the sweep's 300 s floor; re-recording is optional. tests/test__filed_returns.py (_crlf_cases), tools/affected.py (_scan), tools/sweep-selftests.py and tools/verify.sh (path references) are unchanged: no name they use was touched and the file path is the same.
outcome.descriptive: sr39 now shows that one deadline covers both runs using a witness and a heartbeat, not a sleep sized against the deadline, so it holds on any runner speed.

testsAdded: sr39 rewritten: a witness suite whose second run beats until killed. The deadline doubles until the second run is reached, and the last heartbeat must come before the first run's stamp plus the deadline plus half the hold.
